core_representation_observation.statement: After the mixed killer control, frozen V1.1 permits verified derived DAG roots as guards of GUARDED_ITE. Therefore its Boolean DAG language polynomially simulates ordinary Boolean circuits.
core_representation_observation.affine_note: AFFINE_XOR is an additional compact primitive. If translated to a standard bounded-fanin Boolean basis, an affine node with support t has O(t) circuit overhead.
core_representation_observation.forward_translation: A bounded-fanin Boolean circuit of size s can be translated gate-by-gate to O(s) V1.1 GUARDED_ITE/CONST nodes, modulo input/affine representation.
core_representation_observation.reverse_translation: A V1.1 DAG can be translated to a standard Boolean circuit with polynomial overhead in DAG nodes plus total AFFINE_XOR support size.
core_representation_observation.consequence: A strong superpolynomial lower bound on unrestricted V1.1 witness-DAG size for an explicit Boolean function would entail a comparably strong lower-bound problem for general Boolean circuits. Do not make raw unrestricted representation pressure the default experimental frontier.
core_representation_observation.scope_firewall: This does NOT say synthesis is easy. It separates representation existence from the cost of uniformly finding a proof-carrying DAG and from local proof/domain obligations.

published_candidate_triage.known_separation: Hard for selected QBF proof systems via restricted strategy-extraction/circuit models.
published_candidate_triage.reason: The strategy is parity-like; AFFINE_XOR gives an immediate compact V1.1 representation. Useful only as proof-system route comparison.

published_candidate_triage.known_separation: Exponential separations among QBF proof systems.
published_candidate_triage.reason: Published winning strategies are direct equality/copy functions such as u_i=x_i and v_j=y_j, giving immediate affine/identity V1.1 witnesses.

published_candidate_triage.known_separation: Exponential hardness for Q-Resolution and stronger resolution/expansion systems in published work.
published_candidate_triage.reason: A published universal winning strategy sets x_i from an earlier existential choice (e.g. x_i=d_i in a standard formulation), so witness representation itself is simple. The lower bound is proof-system-specific, not a V1.1 representation lower bound.

published_candidate_triage.candidate: Completion Principle / Trapdoor / Lonsing via QBFFam
published_candidate_triage.reason: QBFFam literature presents these as easy families for the proof systems under discussion; they are benchmark controls rather than hard scientific targets.

published_candidate_triage.known_separation: Exponential lower bounds for QBF analogues of resolution, Cutting Planes and Polynomial Calculus; random family hard with high probability.
published_candidate_triage.reason: Cost/capacity lower bounds constrain particular QBF proof systems and number/structure of responses, not directly unrestricted V1.1 circuit size. A faithful V1.1 source-to-certificate mapping must be defined before any experiment.

published_candidate_triage.candidate: QRAT duality/select formulas from expansion strategy-extraction hardness
published_candidate_triage.known_separation: Polynomial-time strategy extraction from unrestricted refutational QRAT would imply P=PSPACE in the cited construction.
published_candidate_triage.reason: This attacks proof-to-strategy extraction access, which is closer to the V1.1 frontier, but the hardness is parameterized by an embedded arbitrary QBF rather than a single explicit finite benchmark family.

published_candidate_triage.known_separation: Sound/complete synthesis proof system with polynomial-time Skolem/Herbrand extraction and conditional lower-bound/orthogonality results.
published_candidate_triage.reason: The scientifically useful question is translation overhead and fragment simulation between V1.1 and SynQBF, not another raw scaling series.

current_decision.reason: No candidate examined in this pass simultaneously satisfies published + directly executable + not analytically discharged + lower-bound/model separation that transfers to the exact V1.1 proof model.
current_decision.next_best_work: Formalize a V1.1 representation-equivalence lemma and then study proof-to-witness translation/extraction overhead against SynQBF/QRAT-style systems before authorizing any new hostile.
